sections.heading: Privacy policy.
sections.body: How we handle the details you give us.

## What we collect

Your name, phone number, email address and postcode, plus anything you type into a form. Nothing else, and no tracking beyond basic traffic counts.

## Why we collect it

To arrange an inspection, quote the treatment, carry it out and send your field report. That is the whole list.

## What we do not do

We do not sell your details, share them with marketing companies, or add you to a mailing list you did not ask for.

## How long we keep it

Enquiries that do not become jobs are deleted after twelve months. Records of completed treatments are kept for seven years, because pesticide-use regulations, warranty and tax require it.

## Your rights

Ask us what we hold and we will tell you. Ask us to delete it and we will, unless we are legally required to keep it.

**This is sample text for a template and is not legal advice.** Replace it with a policy reviewed for your jurisdiction before launch.
